Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser

Class FindScript

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.FindScript
public final class FindScript extends Object
Builds the JavaScript that powers the inline find bar (highlight-all with a live "n of m" match count, next/prev cycling and clear) and parses the count the script returns. Replaces the previous naive window.find call, which neither highlighted every match nor reported how many there were.

The query is embedded through escapeJs(java.lang.String) so it can never break out of its JS string literal (script injection via the find field). The scripts themselves are plain strings, and parseCounts(java.lang.Object) turns the script's "active:total" result into ints, so all of it is unit-tested headlessly even though the DOM walk only runs inside WebKit.

  • Method Details

    • escapeJs

      public static String escapeJs(String text)
      Escapes text for safe inclusion inside a single-quoted JavaScript string literal. null becomes the empty string.
      Parameters:
      text - the raw query (may be null)
      Returns:
      the JS-escaped text, never null

    • highlightScript

      public static String highlightScript(String query)
      The highlight-all script for query. It clears any previous highlights, wraps every case-insensitive match in a <mark>, scrolls to the first one and returns "active:total" (active is 1-based, or 0 when there are none). A blank query clears and returns "0:0".
      Parameters:
      query - the search text (may be null/blank)
      Returns:
      the JavaScript to run on the engine, never null

    • nextScript

      public static String nextScript()
      The next-match script: advances the active highlight (wrapping).

    • prevScript

      public static String prevScript()
      The previous-match script: moves the active highlight back (wrapping).

    • clearScript

      public static String clearScript()
      The clear script: removes every highlight and forgets the state.

    • installHelpersScript

      public static String installHelpersScript()
      Defines the two helpers (lg3dFindStyle, lg3dFindClear, lg3dFindActivate) once, so the per-keystroke scripts stay small. Injected before the first find of a page.
      Returns:
      the JavaScript that installs the helpers, never null

    • parseCounts

      public static int[] parseCounts(Object result)
      Parses a script result of the form "active:total" into a two-element int array {active, total}. Tolerates null, an already-numeric result, or a malformed string (yielding {0,0}).
      Parameters:
      result - the value returned by executeScript (may be null)
      Returns:
      {active, total}, never null, both non-negative
